author: nickyeow

english.text: The tropical rainforests, located in a narrow region near the equator, are disappearing so fast that by the year 2000 eighty percent of them may be gone.

jyutping: hai2 cek3 dou6 fu6 gan6 jat1 go3 haap6 zaak3 keoi1 wik6 ge3 jit6 daai3 jyu5 lam4，ji4 gaa1 bat1 dyun6 gam3 bei2 jan4 leoi6 po3 waai6 gan2，jyu6 gai3 hai2 ji6 ling4 ling4 ling4 nin4 zi1 cin4，go2 go3 keoi1 wik6 wui5 jau5 ng5 fan1 zi1 sei3 ge3 jit6 daai3 jyu5 lam4 hai2 dei6 kau4 dou6 siu1 sat1。
text: 喺赤道附近一個狹窄區域嘅熱帶雨林，而家不斷咁俾人類破壞緊，預計喺二零零零年之前，嗰個區域會有五分之四嘅熱帶雨林喺地球度消失。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He had a lot of work to do.

jyutping: keoi5 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 zou6。
text: 佢有好多嘢要做。

english.text: If you are going to smoke, please go outside.

jyutping: sik6 jin1 m4 goi1 heoi3 ceot1 min6 sik6 aa1。
text: 食煙唔該去出面食吖。

english.text: There is no need to be frightened. He won't harm you.

english.text: Hamisi wants sugar.

text: Hamisi想要糖。

english.text: Why are you the way that you are?

english.text: I had no idea it would put you to so much trouble.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 wui5 gaau2 dou3 nei5 gam3 maa4 faan4。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I'm not going to tell them that.

jyutping: m4 wui5 waa6 bei2 keoi5 dang2 zi1 ne1 di1 si6。
text: 唔會話畀渠等知呢啲事。

english.text: Here's a story about another planet. It's a very distant planet, with two suns in its blue sky, Fortulo and Belulo. A child asks her mother, "Mom, why are there two suns in the sky?" The mother says, "Now what kind of question is that? How many eyes do you have? Two. How many hands do you have? Two." The child responds, "But, Mom, I only have one nose."

jyutping: ni1 dou6 jau5 go3 gwaan1 jyu1 ling6 jat1 go3 sing1 kau4 ge3 gu3 si6，keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 jyun5 ge3 sing1 kau4，keoi5 ge3 laam4 tin1 jau5 loeng5 go3 taai3 joeng4，fuk1 tou4 lok3 tung4 bui3 lou5 lok3。jau5 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 man6 keoi5 aa3 maa1：「maa4 mi4，dim2 gaai2 tin1 soeng6 jau5 loeng5 go3 taai3 joeng4？」maa1 maa1 waa6：「ji4 gaa1 hai6 me1 man6 tai4？nei5 jau5 gei2 do1 zek3 ngaan5？loeng5 zek3。nei5 jau5 gei2 do1 zek3 sau2？loeng5 zek3。」go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 daap3：「daan6 hai6，maa1 mi4，ngo5 zing6 hai6 jau5 jat1 zek3 bei6。」
text: 呢度有個關於另一個星球嘅故事，佢係一個好遠嘅星球，佢嘅藍天有兩個太陽，福圖洛同貝魯洛。有個小朋友問佢阿媽：「媽咪，點解天上有兩個太陽？」媽媽話：「而家係咩問題？你有幾多隻眼？兩隻。你有幾多隻手？兩隻。」個小朋友答：「但係，媽咪，我淨係有一隻鼻。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: There are two contradicting emotions within the human heart. Needless to say, there isn't a person who doesn't feel empathy towards other's misfortunes. However, when you see a person finally able to overcome their misfortunes it is possible to feel a sense of dissatisfaction. To exaggerate a little, it leaves you with a sense that you want to see that person fall into the same misfortune again. Before you know it you unwillingly harbour a sense of hostility towards them.

jyutping: jan4 ge3 sam1 jap6 min6 jau5 loeng5 zung2 maau4 teon5 ge3 cing4 seoi5，m4 sai2 gong2，mou5 jat1 go3 jan4 m4 wui6 deoi3 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 bat1 hang6 gam2 dou3 tung4 cing4。daan6 hai6，dong1 nei5 gin3 dou3 jat1 go3 jan4 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 hak1 fuk6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 bat1 hang6，nei5 ho2 nang4 wui6 gam2 dou3 bat1 mun5。kwaa1 zoeng1 siu2 siu2，ni1 go3 wui6 ling6 nei5 jau5 zung2 gam2 gok3，zau6 hai6 nei5 soeng2 gin3 dou3 go2 go3 jan4 zoi3 ci3 haam6 jap6 tung4 joeng6 ge3 bat1 hang6，hai2 nei5 m4 gok3 ji3 zi1 cin4，nei5 zau6 m4 jyun6 ji3 deoi3 keoi5 dei6 pou5 jau5 dik6 ji3。
text: 人嘅心入面有兩種矛盾嘅情緒，唔使講，冇一個人唔會對其他人嘅不幸感到同情。但係，當你見到一個人終於可以克服佢哋嘅不幸，你可能會感到不滿。誇張少少，呢個會令你有種感覺，就係你想見到嗰個人再次陷入同樣嘅不幸，喺你唔覺意之前，你就唔願意對佢哋抱有敵意。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: A ballpoint pen is a technology. A plow is a technology. A can-opener is technology. There is always some level of technology. Someone told me that Western women do not want to live in the future. They like the past. But they have to choose a level of technology, just the same, as the horse and buggy are also just technology. Why should women have children if they do not believe in the future? There are religious groups, such as the Amish, who choose retrogressive technology.

jyutping: jyun4 zyu1 bat1 hai6 jat1 zung2 gei6 seot6。lai4 hai6 jat1 zung2 gei6 seot6。hoi1 gun3 hei3 zau6 hai6 fo1 gei6。zung2 jau5 jat1 ding6 seoi2 ping4 ge3 fo1 gei6。jau5 jan4 tung4 ngo5 gong2，sai1 fong1 neoi5 jan4 m4 soeng2 hai2 zoeng1 loi4 saang1 wut6。keoi5 dei6 zung1 ji3 gwo3 heoi3。daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 jiu3 gaan2 jat1 go3 gei6 seot6 seoi2 ping4，zau6 jat1 joeng6，jan1 wai6 maa5 tung4 siu2 ce1 dou1 zi2 hai6 gei6 seot6。jyu4 gwo2 neoi5 jan4 m4 soeng1 seon3 mei6 loi4，dim2 gaai2 jiu3 saang1 zai2？jau5 di1 zung1 gaau3 tyun4 tai2，lai6 jyu4 aa3 mai5 sam6 jan4，keoi5 dei6 wui6 syun2 zaak6 teoi3 faa3 gei6 seot6。
text: 圓珠筆係一種技術。犁係一種技術。開罐器就係科技。總有一定水平嘅科技。有人同我講，西方女人唔想喺將來生活。佢哋鍾意過去。但係佢哋要揀一個技術水平，就一樣，因為馬同小車都只係技術。如果女人唔相信未來，點解要生仔？有啲宗教團體，例如阿米什人，佢哋會選擇退化技術。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: This opening chapter will seem to the reader to have nothing to do with my narrative; and yet there would have been no narrative without it, for it is only when a man goes out into the world with the thought that there are heroisms all round him, and with the desire all alive in his heart to follow any which may come within sight of him, that he breaks away as I did from the life he knows, and ventures forth into the wonderful mystic twilight land where lie the great adventures and the great rewards.

jyutping: ni1 go3 hoi1 tau4 ge3 zoeng1 zit3 deoi3 duk6 ze2 lai4 gong2 ci5 fu4 tung4 ngo5 ge3 gu3 si6 mou5 mat1 gwaan1 hai6；daan6 hai6 jyu4 gwo2 mou5 ni1 go3 gu3 si6，zau6 m4 wui6 jau5 jam6 ho4 gu3 si6，jan1 wai6 zi2 jau5 dong1 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 dou3 ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3，nam2 zyu6 keoi5 zau1 wai4 dou1 jau5 jing1 hung4 zing1 san4，tung4 maai4 keoi5 sam1 zung1 wut6 zyu6 ge3 hot3 mong6 heoi3 gan1 ceoi4 jam6 ho4 ho2 nang4 hai2 keoi5 ngaan5 cin4 ceot1 jin6 ge3 si6，keoi5 sin1 wui6 hou2 ci5 ngo5 gam2 tyut3 lei4 keoi5 so2 zi1 dou3 ge3 sang1 wut6，heoi3 mou6 him2，heoi3 taam3 sok3 ngo5 so2 zi1 dou3 ge3 wai5 daai6 mou6 him2。
text: 呢個開頭嘅章節對讀者嚟講似乎同我嘅故事冇乜關係；但係如果冇呢個故事，就唔會有任何故事，因為只有當一個人去到呢個世界，諗住佢周圍都有英雄精神，同埋佢心中活住嘅渴望去跟隨任何可能喺佢眼前出現嘅事，佢先會好似我噉脫離佢所知道嘅生活，去冒險，去探索我所知道嘅偉大冒險。
